errors.text_span: и е маркирана с последователни числа, последвани от датите на всеки ред
errors.evidence: This phrase is nonsensical and does not accurately describe the x-axis labels, which are simply the years from 2004 to 2019.

errors.text_span: достигайки до 40, с интервали на 5 милиарда евро
errors.evidence: The vertical axis ranges from 0 to 70, not 40, and the major tick intervals are every 10 units, not 5.

errors.text_span: Най-високите стълбове съответстват на 2018 и 2019 година, където стойностите са 30,2 и 32,1 милиарда евро, съответно.
errors.evidence: The description confuses the values of individual segments with the total height of the bars. The values 30.2 and 32.1 correspond to the 'Внос' (import) segment for 2017 and 2018, not the total values for 2018 and 2019. The total values for 2018 and 2019 are approximately 60.6 and 64.1 billion EUR, respectively.

errors.text_span: Най-ниските стълбове съответстват на 2004 и 2005 година, където стойностите са 8,0 и 9,4 милиарда евро, съответно.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly uses the values of the 'Износ' (export) segments (8.0 and 9.4) as the total values for the bars in 2004 and 2005. The actual total values (heights of the bars) are 19.6 for 2004 and 24.0 for 2005.

errors.text_span: Някои стълбове са визуално подчертани чрез засенчване, за да се разграничат стойностите на "Внос" и "Износ".
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the chart's structure. It is a stacked bar chart where all bars, not 'some', are composed of two segments representing 'Внос' (Imports) and 'Износ' (Exports). The description fails to identify the fundamental stacked nature of the chart.
